questions.stem: How many length-3 strings over size-4 alphabet? Give the exact answer, using only the information above.
questions.explanation: Each of the 3 positions has 4 choices, so there are 4^3=64 strings. Multiplying would ignore the independent choice at each position.
questions.hint: Multiply alphabet size once per position.
